win_system.notes: A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols that were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

wilds.name: Multiplier Wild
wilds.behavior: The Multiplier Wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the bonus and burst symbols.

multipliers.name: Multiplier Wild
multipliers.behavior: The Multiplier Wild symbol substitutes for any symbol except the bonus and burst symbols.

specials.name: Burst
specials.behavior: The burst symbol is a blocker symbol that is activated at the end of the game round when nothing else can happen. It changes itself and its adjacent symbols into the same payout symbol or into Coins, it does not transform into wild. Coins, bonus symbols and Multiplier Wilds are not affected.

base_game_loop.summary: Ryze 2: paid spin on 7x6. A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected.. Avalanche/tumble after wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 7x6. Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: Evaluate wins
phases.what_happens: Evaluate wins: A winning cluster consists of 5 or more identical symbols which are either vertically or horizontally connected.

phases.name: Remove winners and Avalanche
phases.what_happens: All cluster wins in the current symbol drop are collected. Thereafter, all symbols that were part of a winning combination explode. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.
phases.ends_when: No new winning combinations after a fill
phases.state_changes: Grid updated; avalanche chain may continue

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
